newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-SocGen raises Dixons target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-SocGen raises Dixons target.

text.p: Analysts at Societe Generale Strauss Turnbull on Thursday raised their short-term share price target for Dixons to seven pounds from six.
Dixons shares had climbed 26p to 621-1/2p by 1055 GMT.
Retail analyst Nick Bubb raised his six-month target to seven ponds in response to the recent advance and repeated his "buy" recommendation on the stock.
"I think there's a lot more to go for, quite frankly," Bubb said. "It's a pretty visible high quality growth stock."
"It should be up on 18/19 times earnings so it still looks cheap."
